# Scale predictably

Pay only for what you use. Simple, transparent pricing for all Cloudflare products

### Free

For personal or hobby projects that aren't business-critical.

[Get started](https://dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up)

### Pro

For professional websites that aren't business-critical.

/mo billed annually, or $25/mo billed monthly

[Get started](https://dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up?pt=p)

### Business

For small businesses operating online.

/mo billed annually, or $250/mo billed monthly

[Get started](https://dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up?pt=b)

Billed annually

## Get more from Cloudflare

Take your performance and security even further with Cloudflare's paid add-ons.

#### Smart Shield + Argo Smart Routing

Optimized routes across the Cloudflare network for faster, more reliable, secure responses. Includes Smart Routing and Tiered Caching.

Starting at $5/mo[Activate](/products/argo-smart-routing/)

#### Load Balancing

Local and global traffic load balancing, geographic routing, health checks, and failover for continuous availability.

Starting at $5/mo[Activate](https://www.cloudflare.com/products/load-balancing/)

#### Stream

Video storage, encoding, and playback. Pro and Business plans get 100 free minutes of video stored and 10,000 minutes of delivery.

Starting at $5/mo[Activate](/products/cloudflare-stream/)

#### Automatic Platform Optimization (APO)

WordPress optimization with CDN, intelligent caching, and other key optimizations. Go up to 300% faster.

$5/mo (Free plan);  
included with Pro/Biz/Ent[Speed Up My Site](https://cloudflare.com/products/automatic-platform-optimization)

#### Cache Reserve

Persistent object storage for cache, eliminates egress costs while saving your origin servers from unnecessary requests.

Usage-based[Activate](/products/cache-reserve/)

#### Log Explorer

Meet log retention requirements, quickly detect security and performance issues, investigate root cause, and mitigate impact.

$1/GB ingested;  
first 10 GB free[Activate](/products/log-explorer/)

#### Advanced Certificate Manager

Flexible certificate issuance and management for your domains.

$10/mo[Activate](https://www.cloudflare.com/products/ssl/)

#### Client-Side Security

Defend against client-side attacks on JavaScript dependencies.

$0.099/1k requests[Activate](https://developers.cloudflare.com/client-side-security/?_gl=1*8j935e*_gcl_au*NDQyNDc1NDY4LjE3Nzg2MTc4MDU.*_ga*NWY2ZmU5NTQtMjFkMi00NmEyLTg5OTMtMWU2ZjRmOGU3ODZi*_ga_SQCRB0TXZW*czE3Nzg2ODMzODgkbzIkZzAkdDE3Nzg2ODMzODgkajYwJGwwJGgw)

Starting at $7.85[Register](/products/registrar/)
